title: Pulse event recording record (v1)
description: One JSON object per line (JSONL). A recording is a single 'header' line, then any number of 'event' lines ordered by seq, then an optional 'trailer' line. Discriminated by the 'kind' field.

header.description: Run metadata, written once as the first line.

recorder.description: Recorder name/version that produced this file.

source.description: Source identity, e.g. engine name or host.

typeFingerprint.description: Composite datum-type fingerprint from RunInfo, or null if unverifiable.

event.description: One dispatched event. 'seq' is the authoritative order (dispatch order); timestamps are for display, not ordering.

seq.description: Per-run monotonic dispatch sequence. Gaps indicate dropped records.

observedAt.description: Wall-clock instant the tap saw the event (not gateway receipt time). Meaningful in real time; informational in compressed-time replay.

typeId.description: datum TYPE_ID; used for filtering and colour without parsing the payload.

payload.description: The datum serialized as a JSON object (its fields). typeId + payload together are equivalent to tagged JSON, flattened.

trailer.description: Final line with completion status and full accounting, so a failed or lossy recording cannot look complete. Identity: observed = events + overflow + serializationErrors + abandoned.

serializationErrors.description: Events that failed to serialize and were skipped.

abandoned.description: Observed but neither written, overflowed, nor serialization-failed (queued-but-unwritten, or rejected after stop or failure).
